chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Isḥaq ibn ʿAmmār from Abū ʿAbdillāh (peace be upon him) who said:

"If it were not for the favor Allah has bestowed upon people by the Farewell Circumambulation (Ṭawāf al-Wadāʿ), they would return to their homes and it would not be permissible for them to touch their wives." He means that the wives do not become permissible to them until he returns and performs another circuit around the House after he has walked between Ṣafā and al-Marwah, and that is obligatory upon women and men.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling of Farewell Circumambulation (Tawaf al-Wada) regarding marital intimacy after Hajj?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to clarify that Ṭawāf al-Wadāʿ is a mandatory condition (shart) for the resumption of marital intimacy after Hajj, rather than merely a recommended act. This ruling applies equally to men and women, emphasizing that the marital bond remains suspended until the final circumambulation of the Kaaba is completed following the Sa'i. The hadith underscores the completeness of the Hajj ritual, linking the physical act of worship directly to the legal status of the pilgrim's family life.
